**ARC-AGI-2 | Morning edition — October 8**

Tufa Labs leads the public board at 83.61. rabbithole follows at 80.56, Yi-Chia Chen at 77.22 and nvbanana at 76.67: the front four are 6.94 points apart. ALbert RUehlman is fifth at 66.81.

One observed score event moved Jack Cole from 26th to 17th at 10:42 p.m. Eastern. The feed has no usable UTC midnight baseline, so a net overnight gain or current rank for Jack Cole cannot be inferred from that event. The provisional public gold line is 37.36 across 2,558 teams. Final medals depend on the private board.

Standings observed at 5:43 a.m. Eastern; later evaluations may change them. [Full report](https://arc.markbarney.net/news/2026-10-08-morning-arc-2)
headline: Tufa Labs leads an ARC-AGI-2 front four split by seven points

sections.heading: Four teams at the front
sections.text: Tufa Labs leads the ARC-AGI-2 public board at 83.61 in the 5:43 a.m. Eastern snapshot. rabbithole is second at 80.56, Yi-Chia Chen third at 77.22 and nvbanana fourth at 76.67. Just 6.94 points separate first from fourth. ALbert RUehlman is fifth at 66.81, a larger gap of 9.86 points behind fourth place. These are current positions, not verified overnight changes: the feed has no usable observation at the UTC midnight comparison baseline.

sections.heading: A move recorded below the leaders
sections.text: The feed records Jack Cole moving from 26th at 33.61 to 17th at 36.94 in a score event observed at 10:42 p.m. Eastern. That is a recorded move, not proof of a net overnight gain or a current 17th-place standing. The closing snapshot puts _hans sixth at 60.42, Dawid Kopiczko seventh at 55.00, Majkel1337 eighth at 48.33, ARC Raiders ninth at 47.22 and Khaotic Sethesis tenth at 45.83.

sections.heading: What the morning board can tell us
sections.text: The public gold line is 37.36 among 2,558 teams in the closing observation. Jan Disselhoff stands 1,585th at 14.17 in that snapshot. Without a usable midnight baseline, the board does not establish which leading teams gained or lost ground overnight. The observation was made before the 6 a.m. issue cutoff, and further submission evaluations may alter these standings. Public medal bands remain provisional; private results decide final medals.
